issue.title: Ensure that Vert.x's ConnectionBase#remoteAddress does not return null
issue.body:
This is done for the Amazon lambda stuff in order to ensure
that tracing works properly.
The remote address is currently set to the local Quarkus server,
which seems to make most sense.

Fixes: #25708

body:
The fix will be in 2.10.

You can of course build the code from source to check and make sure it works
